text:
Just got a call from Jess at the Saint John station. She was doing the morning rounds and
SCADA popped a pressure alarm at 06:40. Reading was 6,550 kPa, MOP is 6,000. She walked
the pump bay, didn't see any product on the ground or dripping. Shut the unit down,
pressure dropped back to line pack. Pump housing looks okay, no visible cracks or leaks.
Contractor ops tech was there on shift, said he'd checked the seals at midnight and
everything was tight. Jess is going to pull the pressure chart and log it. That's all we know
right now.
- Raj, Field Ops On-call
